statement: Write exactly id,segment_id,thickness_pred; one unique finite numeric mm prediction per requested segment; no extra index or diagnostic columns.
The forecast target is minimum residual wall thickness in millimetres, not defect depth, nominal wall, corrosion rate or a unitless score.
Keep the UZT inspection-priority table separate from result.csv.
Report Pearson correlation squared, signed Pearson r, separate R2, MAE, RMSE, bias and MAPE with explicit undefined/near-zero policy.
Apply time eligibility before persistence, aggregation, imputation or feature selection; timestamp < prediction date at 00:00.
Cold start excludes target-pipe VTD/UZT-derived inputs even if present in the archive.
Preserve source bytes and publish only after checks; source changes during a run fail the run.
Account explicitly for every supplied field and every rejected/masked value; preserve unknown archival columns.
